fields.name: context
fields.description: Inspected target and capability/environment snapshot; refreshed only by explicit commands.

fields.name: destination
fields.description: Resolved absolute path; fixed for the session; rerun --config to change.

fields.name: preset
fields.description: Chosen configuration basis: default, minimal, banner, prompt, server, or existing.

fields.name: draft
fields.description: Editable complete config, including preserved display, module options, face and style settings.

fields.name: selected_modules
fields.description: Unique ordered enabled IDs; face appended on enabling if not already present.

fields.name: selected_fields
fields.description: Module to chosen field; absent means default module text.

fields.name: field_queue
fields.description: Enabled modules with declared fields, in selection order, captured on modules.submit.

fields.name: field_index
fields.description: Index of the active prompt in field_queue.

fields.name: face_enabled
fields.description: Whether format references face; disabling preserves inactive face options.

fields.name: sample_seed
fields.description: Ephemeral preview seed; persisted only for random-once.

fields.name: face_sample
fields.description: Static sample matching current identity and expression.

fields.name: format_dirty
fields.description: Selection/field/order edits require normalized token-join format; otherwise preserve custom literals.

fields.name: shell_choice
fields.description: bash, zsh, fish, none; detected SHELL is only a suggestion.

fields.name: review_data
fields.description: Exact bytes and preview; invalidated by edits.

fields.name: authorized
fields.description: One-use consent bound to reviewed bytes and target fingerprint.

fields.name: committed
fields.description: True only after atomic publication; cannot transition to cancellation terminal afterward.

fields.name: error_text
fields.description: Current prompt or command diagnostic; never written to stdout.

fields.name: result_text
fields.description: Saved path on success; no stdout content on precommit failure.

fields.name: cursor
fields.description: Current option highlight; UI navigation does not accept values.

invariants.expression: NOT authorized AND NOT committed => no config/temporary/directory writes
invariants.description: Reads and previews cannot create filesystem state.

invariants.expression: draft.face.random == true => draft.face.seed absent AND draft.face.preset absent; otherwise at most one of seed,preset
invariants.description: Three on-disk sources: preset, seed, random.

invariants.expression: face_mode == random-once => saved face.seed == sample_seed AND saved face.random absent
face_mode == random-each-run => saved face.random == true AND sample_seed is never serialized
invariants.description: Generate one ephemeral identity per future invocation.

invariants.expression: runtime random identity is resolved once and reused for all expression/frame renders in that invocation
invariants.description: No random change between frames or repeated face tokens.

invariants.expression: selected_modules has unique supported IDs; length >= 1 before leaving modules.ready; selected_fields keys are a subset of selected_modules
commit input bytes == review_data.toml AND input snapshot == context fingerprint
invariants.description: Any edit or refresh clears authorization.

invariants.expression: stdout contains only saved absolute path + newline after commit; all interaction and diagnostics use stderr
invariants.description: No JSON mode or piped input.
Signals after the publication boundary cannot promise no writes.

invariants.expression: review preparation does not change sample_seed
invariants.description: Every-run sample is stable until explicit reroll or identity change.

invariants.expression: selected_fields has at most one entry per module; every value is empty or a field declared by that module
invariants.description: One format token per module, optionally with one declared field selector.

commands.side_effect: Read only: parse smol init [--config PATH] [--help], reject other options/positionals; help precedes TTY checks. Require stdin and stderr TTY. Resolve explicit path > XDG_CONFIG_HOME > HOME, reject absent destination; ignore XDG_CONFIG_DIRS for init writes. Lstat target and parent components; refuse symlinks/special files. Read bytes and mode, SHA-256 snapshot, parse with extended config schema. Malformed existing TOML becomes a visible replacement warning and disables Existing preset. Permission/read failures emit inspect.failed. No directories, lock files, temp files or config writes.
Build a static character using the current face preset/seed API and selected expression (idle initially). Pure computation; no persistence, animation or subprocesses.

Read 16 bytes from injected OS entropy, encode as 32 lowercase hex characters, build using that seed and emit sample plus seed. A reroll reads fresh bytes. No seed is printed in every-run mode or persisted until save. Entropy failure is explicit. No fallback to a fixed face.

Read-only validation and serialization of exact TOML, including preserved display/module options and {module:field} tokens; include random=true only in every-run mode, with seed/preset absent. Static system preview uses injected providers and the existing 20ms renderer budget; unavailable modules vanish with normal separator semantics. Every-run preview reuses session sample_seed: preparing review never rerolls. Return exact TOML bytes, sample and shell instructions; no config writes or subprocesses.

Only after explicit Yes: recheck target snapshot (existence, device/inode, SHA-256 bytes, mode), reject unsafe targets and drift. Create missing parents with 0700, same-directory exclusive temp file 0600, write exact reviewed bytes, preserve existing regular-file permissions, sync and close; recheck snapshot immediately before atomic rename. For absent destination use atomic no-replace publication; never clobber a newly created file. Cancel before commit deletes temp and newly created empty parents. Existing-file replacement uses atomic rename; external writes in the last check-to-rename interval cannot be excluded without cooperating writers. Block cancellation across the short publication critical section; successful publication always emits save.committed, even if a signal arrives then. No automatic retries. No backups or shell-file edits.

Read-only target inspection and fingerprint refresh, same safe-target rules as initial inspection. Retain draft; malformed changed file is a warning and replacement still needs explicit review and confirmation.

Write absolute saved path plus one newline to stdout. Write Saved confirmation and shell setup instructions to stderr, using the exact destination safely quoted. Output failure returns 1 and states that config WAS saved; never retry commit or remove a saved config.

Cancel workers, discard stale outcomes, remove uncommitted temp files and only newly created empty parents, restore input mode/cursor and finish the current stderr line. Never delete or alter a committed config. Completion is reported once cleanup is synchronous/awaited.

Cancel workers after SIGTERM, discard stale outcomes, remove uncommitted temp files and only newly created empty parents, restore input mode/cursor and finish the current stderr line. Never delete or alter a committed config. Completion is reported once cleanup is synchronous/awaited.

Read only: parse smol init [--config PATH] [--help], reject other options/positionals; help precedes TTY checks. Require stdin and stderr TTY. Resolve explicit path > XDG_CONFIG_HOME > HOME, reject absent destination; ignore XDG_CONFIG_DIRS for init writes. Lstat target and parent components; refuse symlinks/special files. Read bytes and mode, SHA-256 snapshot, parse with extended config schema. Malformed existing TOML becomes a visible replacement warning and disables Existing preset. Permission/read failures emit inspect.failed. No directories, lock files, temp files or config writes.
Generate a fresh random character sample; identical to face.roll but dispatched by the explicit Reroll action.

Read 16 bytes from injected OS entropy, encode as 32 lowercase hex characters, build using that seed and emit sample plus seed. A reroll reads fresh bytes. No seed is printed in every-run mode or persisted until save. Entropy failure is explicit. No fallback to a fixed face.
Build a static character using the current face preset/seed API and selected expression (idle initially). Pure computation; no persistence, animation or subprocesses.

Read-only validation and serialization of exact TOML, including preserved display/module options and {module:field} tokens; include random=true only in every-run mode, with seed/preset absent. Static system preview uses injected providers and the existing 20ms renderer budget; unavailable modules vanish with normal separator semantics. Every-run preview reuses session sample_seed: preparing review never rerolls. Return exact TOML bytes, sample and shell instructions; no config writes or subprocesses.
Regenerate validated TOML, fingerprint, preview and instructions after a conflict refresh; never rerolls the sample seed.

fields.name: display
fields.description: Display precision and unit controls; preserved unchanged by this wizard.

fields.name: modules
fields.description: Per-module options; preserved unchanged by this wizard.

fields.name: format
fields.description: Validated template; tokens may be {module} or {module:field}.

fields.name: style
fields.description: Per-module foreground and bold; default palette covers every system module.

fields.name: face
fields.description: Extended face options; random flag is proposed new runtime behavior.

fields.name: preset
fields.description: Known named character; omitted when seed/random is selected.

fields.name: seed
fields.description: Deterministic identity; random-once stores generated seed here.

fields.name: random
fields.description: NEW: true generates one identity per invocation; absent/false retains existing behavior.

fields.name: fg
fields.description: Terminal default empty string or known named color.

fields.name: bold
fields.description: Preserved from preset/existing config; no bold editor in this scope.

fields.name: toml
fields.description: Exact bytes displayed and committed, including trailing newline.

fields.name: instructions
fields.description: Safely quoted shell commands; not executed.

fields.name: states
fields.description: From face.States(), idle first; remaining sorted.

fields.name: draft
fields.description: In-memory answers including untouched display and module options.

fields.name: fieldQueue
fields.description: Modules with declared fields awaiting a choice.

fields.name: selectedFields
fields.description: Chosen field per module; absent means default text.

fields.name: config
fields.description: Only --config PATH or --config=PATH plus --help are accepted for init.

fields.name: TERM
fields.description: dumb selects plain line-oriented numbered prompts.

fields.name: stdoutTTY
fields.description: May be redirected; does not govern prompting.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Stable preset identifier shown in the prompt.

fields.name: format
fields.description: Format applied by this preset; absent for Existing.

fields.name: color
fields.description: Color mode defined by minimal and default; otherwise preserved.

fields.name: faceState
fields.description: Expression applied by banner; default is idle.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Field selector accepted after a colon.

fields.name: description
fields.description: User-facing field description from the module registry.

fields.name: round
fields.description: Round seconds into the next minute.

fields.name: device
fields.description: Power-supply name; empty selects the first battery.

fields.name: interface
fields.description: Interface name; empty selects the first non-loopback interface.

fields.name: manager
fields.description: Package database; auto probes in order.

sources.description: All screen data assembled from declared fields; no implicit I/O.
Read identifiers without mutating upstream registry; random modes are additional UI choices.

sources.provider: Built-in Default plus presets/minimal.toml, presets/banner.toml, presets/prompt.toml and presets/server.toml
sources.description: Read-only preset definitions; Existing is offered separately when the target parses.
Declared field selectors and descriptions; the registry is not duplicated.
